# olivares_inventory (Data Source)

Reads the reconciled inventory of the Olivares AI control plane estate (read-only): the discovered entities and a roll-up summary. Requires inventory:read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the reconciled estate inventory (read-only).
data "olivares_inventory" "agents" {
  kind = "agent"
}

output "agent_count" {
  value = data.olivares_inventory.agents.summary.total
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `kind` (String) Filter entities by kind (e.g. "agent", "mcp_server", "identity"). Omit for all kinds.
- `status` (String) Filter entities by status. Omit for all statuses.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant UUID, overriding the provider-level tenant. Sent as X-Olivares-Tenant.

### Read-Only

- `entities` (Attributes List) The matching reconciled estate entities. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entities))
- `summary` (Attributes) Estate roll-up: counts by kind and by source plus the total. Reflects the whole estate, not the filtered entity list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--summary))

<a id="nestedatt--entities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entities`

Read-Only:

- `entity_id` (String) Resolved entity id.
- `first_seen` (String) First-seen timestamp.
- `hosts` (List of String) Hosts the entity was seen on.
- `kind` (String) Entity kind.
- `last_seen` (String) Last-seen timestamp.
- `name` (String) Entity name.
- `occurrence_count` (Number) How many times the entity was observed.
- `ref` (String) Logical reference.
- `signal_sources` (List of String) Collectors that observed the entity.
- `status` (String) Entity status.


<a id="nestedatt--summary"></a>
### Nested Schema for `summary`

Read-Only:

- `by_kind` (Map of Number) Entity count per kind.
- `by_source` (Map of Number) Entity count per signal source.
- `total` (Number) Total reconciled entities.
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when the roll-up was bounded by the scan cap (honest gradation).
